script.text: Lanterns sway above the market. At a crowded table, Jono spots you before you can call his name.
There you are! I was beginning to think the palace had swallowed you.
Keep your voice down, Jono. Some of us are trying to help him stay unnoticed.
One duel, then. Nobody leaves my table without giving these dragons a challenge!
Defeat Jono. Watch his Fusion materials: in this version, Fusion Summons use Polymerization and the materials named on the card.
